claims.text: Remote positions itself as 'the infrastructure leading HR platforms trust to deliver global payroll, EOR, and contractor management to their customers.'
Remote claims to operate end-to-end in-house with its own legal experts, payroll specialists, and compliance teams in every market it operates in.
Remote's Meta ads include at least 10 distinct variants focused on its Workday integration, including headlines like 'Your HR already lives in Workday. Your global payroll can too.'
Remote Meta ad copy states its Workday integration is 'run in-house through 100% owned entities across 75 countries.'
Remote Meta ads reference a dataset of '4.8M payslips, 40 markets' to support claims that payroll complexity varies by 'up to 4× across markets.'

Remote Meta ads target a finance leader persona with cost-framing copy such as 'Three costs of running global payroll outside Workday: Hours per cycle you don't track. Risk no one prices. Process knowledge stuck in one head.'
Remote has launched 'Remote MCP,' described as giving AI agents a live, secure connection to payroll, contracts, compliance data, and org structure without API keys or exports.
Remote describes itself as 'API-first by design' with REST API, webhooks, and CLI available for building custom workflows or embedding global employment into other products.
Remote claims '4,000+ reviews' and calls itself 'the #1 global HR platform as voted by you.'
A Remote customer (Luke McKinlay, VP of Finance) states that using Remote saves over $500,000 per year compared to managing operations in-house.
A Remote customer (Erik Sveen, Founder and CEO) states he manages 460+ contractors globally through Remote.
Remote lists native integrations with Workday, HiBob, BambooHR, Personio, and others.
Remote acquired Atlas 'to simplify how global teams spend and scale.'
Remote's press coverage states its 'modern payroll platform surpasses 300% growth.'
Remote press coverage states it 'Sweeps G2's Global Employment Platform Category.'
Remote announced the appointment of a new CBO and expansion of its leadership team 'to meet surging enterprise demand globally.'
Remote announced a partnership with isolved on June 25, 2026, described as unlocking compliant global hiring for 200,000+ US employers.
Remote introduced new AI-native 'Surveys' to transform employee feedback into real-time workforce insights.
Remote's Workday-focused Meta ad campaign uses download-gated content across multiple variants, indicating a sustained paid investment rather than a test.
Remote's positioning as 'infrastructure' for other HR platforms means it is not a complete workforce management system, requiring customers to maintain additional HRIS, IT, and finance tools.
Remote's Workday integration campaign normalizes a two-vendor model (Workday + Remote) that Rippling's unified platform is designed to eliminate.
Remote's MCP and AI features are limited to employment and payroll data, whereas Rippling's unified record spans HR, IT, and Finance across 30+ products.
Remote's isolved partnership targets US SMB/mid-market employers — the same segment where Rippling is the #1 mid-market payroll provider — via embedded channel distribution.
